hypotheses.statement: the linear trend in annual mean T2M is positive, on the order of +0.3 to +0.5 °C/decade (prior from regional literature; the estimate itself is data-driven).

models with an explicit trend or level adjustment beat seasonal naive on RMSE at long horizons mainly because seasonal naive carries one year of noise; averaging over many years in the seasonal component reduces variance. Gains are modest (MASE about 0.75 to 0.95).
ETS and SARIMA with unconstrained adaptive level will not clearly beat the harmonic regression; DM tests will often be insignificant for pairs among the non-naive models.
